CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2589 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 6e4d2b5cf5e9580e20198e2ea282bdb6ef597516. Bus nonce: 1afe5b4278e7d133e4983435156c5638. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 6e4d2b5cf5e9580e20198e2ea282bdb6ef597516 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-fly-gh-read-retry, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-fly-gh-read-retry <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-fly-gh-read-retry; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fixer for PR #2589 (branch fix/r10-fly-gh-read-retry, group R10-FLY-GH-READ-RETRY) at head 6e4d2b5cf5e9580e20198e2ea282bdb6ef597516. Round 2: the latest verdict on origin/review/2589 is blocked again in the same class. Its first line, verbatim:
Fix review: blocked 6e4d2b5cf5e9580e20198e2ea282bdb6ef597516 mutant-survives: gh_transient's classification branches are outside the sweep's rules; deleting the error-connecting-to alternative or widening the 403 grep to any rate limit passes all 218 checks
Read the WHOLE verdict (`git fetch origin review/2589; git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md`) and clear EVERY block and Finding in it.
Root of the repeat: last round's enumeration rule covered the retry loop but not the classifier that feeds it. Close the class this time:
1. Enumerate EVERY alternative in gh_transient (each pattern of the transient set, each anchor or scope such as the 403 / rate-limit grep, and the default branch). For each one, a fixture must pin it from both sides: one input that must be classified transient and one near-miss that must NOT be (for example a non-rate-limit 403). Show that deleting, widening or narrowing each alternative turns a test red.
2. State the rule in the body as a mechanical enumeration (how to list the alternatives from the source, for example a grep, plus the count), so a reviewer can re-derive the list and confirm that every entry has both fixtures.
3. Run the finder's sweep plus your own one-line mutants of gh_transient and of the retry loop. Report survivors as 0, with the mutant list in the body.
Every Carry must name a group present in origin/main:dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json (pr-contract reads main's roster). The roster branch is FROZEN until #2588 merges, so put anything else in ## Forward-carry as append text, with no `Carry:` tag.
Task: start from 6e4d2b5cf5e9580e20198e2ea282bdb6ef597516; merge origin/main (never rebase); follow dev/governance/roles/fixer.md steps 2-8 (failing test first, mutation proof, the finder's harness at both ends, a null control for every quantified claim). Re-take the WHOLE body at your new head (every figure with its command printed beside it), add the new commits to ## Head, and answer ## Red checks from the check-runs API per commit. carry_audit (with and without --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster) must report 0 unrouted and 0 bad. Run prepr with PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Push the handoff and body refs as the runner instructs.
